title: AP Client Load Imbalance
dataSources: UniFi controller events (`unifi:event`), Pi-hole query log (`pihole:query`), AdGuard Home (`adguard:query`), speedtest-cli results (`speedtest:result`), router/firewall syslog, ISP uptime probes (`uptime:probe`).
app: UniFi / router syslog, Pi-hole/AdGuard, and scheduled speedtests via HEC scripted inputs and the Universal Forwarder.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=unifi:event
| stats dc(client_mac) as clients by ap_name
| eventstats avg(clients) as avg_clients
| where clients>avg_clients*1.5
| sort - clients
description: Shows which access points are carrying a disproportionate client load so you can adjust placement, transmit power, or band steering before performance suffers.
value: A lopsided client distribution wastes expensive Wi-Fi hardware because one AP gets cooked while another idles.
implementation: Forward AP and client association data; review client-count skew after big device or layout changes.
visualization: Table of access points by client count versus average.
grandmaExplanation: It maps which Wi-Fi access point is doing much more of the work than the others.
